scope: Bounded primary-source text review of 13 anti-Fab-like and three scFv16-like entries from the historical remainder; no whole-census feasibility or terminal decision.
evidenceBoundary: Primary publication text, article deposition statements, and frozen RCSB metadata/sequences. No coordinate files, structure images, docking labels, or prediction results were inspected.
sourceSummaryStorage: Paraphrases are stored; no full article text or figures are copied.

sources.title: Structure of human Frizzled5 by fiducial-assisted cryo-EM supports a heterodimeric mechanism of canonical Wnt signaling.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Results and discussion / Structure determination and analysis; Materials and methods / Protein expression and purification
roleEvidence.fact: BRIL replacing receptor ICL3 was complexed with anti-BRIL Fab BAG2 and an anti-Fab nanobody. The authors identify the BRIL/Fab/Nb assembly as an image-alignment fiducial. The anti-Fab reagent is attributed to Ereno-Orbea et al. 2018.

sources.title: Structures of atypical chemokine receptor 3 reveal the basis for its promiscuity and signaling bias.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Materials and methods / Cryo-EM sample preparation and data acquisition; Model building and refinement
roleEvidence.fact: The authors added an anti-Fab nanobody to selected receptor-Fab samples, cite Ereno-Orbea et al. 2018 for that reagent, and identify 6WW2 as its model source. CID24 and CID25 are Fabs with separate heavy and light chains.

pdbIdToComplex.7SK5: One of the seven deposited ACKR3 complexes, associated EMDB-25173
pdbIdToComplex.7SK7: One of the seven deposited ACKR3 complexes, associated EMDB-25175

otherAntibodyEvidence.section: Materials and methods / Expression, purification, and characterization of Fabs CID24 and CID25
otherAntibodyEvidence.fact: CID24 and CID25 are Fab reagents; their receptor binding does not make either a VHH.

sources.title: Structures of oxysterol sensor EBI2/GPR183, a key regulator of the immune response.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Results, initial structure-preparation paragraph; STAR Methods, EBI2-BRIL construct and complex preparation
roleEvidence.fact: The authors replaced receptor ICL3 with BRIL, then added anti-BRIL Fab and anti-Fab nanobody to prepare the GSK682753A-bound sample. The nanobody expression construct carries an N-terminal His tag and TEV site; the authors cite Ereno-Orbea 2018 and Tsutsumi 2020 for its preparation.

pdbIdToComplex.7TUY: One of the two deposited EBI2 models; frozen entry title identifies the GSK682753A-bound model

sources.title: A framework for Frizzled-G protein coupling and implications to the PCP signaling pathways.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Results / Structures of three FZDs in the inactive state; Materials and methods / Cloning, expression and purification of miniG-alpha-s, miniG-alpha-q, Nb35 and VHH; Complex formation for cryo-EM sample preparation
roleEvidence.fact: The three receptor-BRIL constructs were separately assembled with anti-BRIL Fab and anti-Fab VHH. Methods identify the VHH as an anti-Fab nanobody expressed with an N-terminal His tag. 6WW2 is the stated source model for the BRIL/Fab/VHH module.

sources.title: Structural insights into neurokinin 3 receptor activation by endogenous and analogue peptide agonists.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Materials and methods / Construct cloning; Expression and purification of the NK3R-Gq complex; Results, first structure-preparation paragraph
roleEvidence.fact: Engineered Gq contains the G-alpha-i1 N-terminus to support antibody binding. Nb35 and scFv16 were used to stabilize these complexes; Fab-G50 was explicitly not added. The receptor construct includes BRIL, LgBiT, and tandem MBP purification modules.

otherAntibodyEvidence.fact: Nb35 was added for all three preparations. The authors report modeled Nb35 only for NKB; they explain its absence from the SP and senktide models by weak or dynamic occupancy.

sources.title: Structural basis of antagonist selectivity in endothelin receptors.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Results / Structure determination of antagonist-bound ETA structures; Materials and methods, antagonist-bound complex preparation
roleEvidence.fact: A BRIL-binding Fab and a nanobody reinforcing the Fab hinge stabilized the receptor construct. Methods name this nanobody anti-Fab Nb and use the 7TUY auxiliary module as a model source. An additional ETA-specific antibody, Fab301, was included.

otherAntibodyEvidence.section: Results / Structure determination of antagonist-bound ETA structures; Materials and methods, complex formation
otherAntibodyEvidence.fact: Fab301 is a receptor-specific Fab and was added together with anti-BRIL Fab and anti-Fab Nb.

sources.title: Structural basis for CCR6 modulation by allosteric antagonists.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Results, BRIL/Fab/Nb sample-preparation paragraph; Methods, model building
roleEvidence.fact: The authors combined an anti-BRIL Fab with an anti-Fab nanobody around receptor-inserted BRIL as an image-alignment fiducial. Methods call the nanobody hinge-binding and cite 6WW2 as the Fab/nanobody model source.

sources.title: Structure basis of ligand recognition and activation of GPR55.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Main text, paragraph describing inactive-state structure preparation
roleEvidence.fact: The authors inserted BRIL at ICL3 and introduced a BRIL-binding Fab with a nanobody reinforcing its hinge to aid particle alignment and stability. They also report an MBP extension on the Fab heavy chain.

sources.title: Development of an antibody fragment that stabilizes GPCR/G-protein complexes.
sources.reviewMethod: Primary article text only; figures and coordinate files were not opened. Facts below are paraphrases.

roleEvidence.section: Results, recognition-mode analysis; Methods, antibody construct cloning
roleEvidence.fact: scFv16 is a single-chain variable fragment derived from mAb16. The authors report recognition of G-alpha-i1 and G-beta1 and stabilization of GPCR/G-protein complexes. Its heavy and light variable regions make it an scFv rather than a VHH.

pdbIdToComplex.6CRK: Gi1/scFv16 complex; contextual reagent-role evidence only, not a newly reviewed census entry
